selection.sourceContext: MapRoomManager.instance.isInMapRoom3; the active client transforms monster costs globally in MR3, not only during combat.
selection.shortArrayPolicy: CREATURES.GetProperty clamps each property independently to its final array value.
selection.excludedReason: C200 is the blocked source AILooter1 entry; the MR3 server monster validation table does not contain it.

crossCheck.method: Exact comparison of all server MR3 property arrays against active client literal data after modifyCreepData.

housing.capacitySource: GLOBAL.SetBuildingProps chooses pristine YARD_PROPS for MR3; HOUSING.HousingSpace counts completed buildings regardless of HP.
housing.destructionSource: BUILDING15.Destroyed halves resident monster HP and skips ordinary Cull/RemoveHouse.

bunker.transferModel: Reserve persistent owned monster with ownerID=bunker ID; return sets ownerID=0. Inventory count remains unchanged.
bunker.persistentFieldNotes: self is a transient MonsterBase reference, not serialized state. Health, owner reservation and healing queue require host-owned persistence.

scope: Exact original numerical data does not implement specialized monster abilities by itself.
Negative damage and additional ability properties are retained as source data; no new combat ability is inferred.
Original research/unlock rules and ordinary catalog values remain unchanged.
Housing/Bunker persistence rules are source requirements, not a claim that all runtime persistence is implemented.
